title: Offline-valid delegation must not substitute for current effect authority
invariant: Offline-valid delegation proves historical bounded delegation, not current permission to perform an effect. Fresh currentness remains a separate requirement.
source_class: WIMSE-style offline-verifiable attenuation and currentness separation

cases.setup: Resolve and retain a valid attenuated two-hop delegation projection before any revocation.
cases.expected: The cached projection remains historical evidence only and explicitly grants no execution authority, even after later authority state changes.

cases.setup: Append a fresher revocation of an upstream delegation grant after the historical projection was created.
cases.expected: A fresh projection from current ledger state fails closed because the upstream grant is revoked.

cases.setup: Present a same-holder root authority whose authority has been narrowed and therefore has a different authority digest from the ledger-bound root.
cases.expected: Projection fails closed on the root-binding mismatch instead of treating historical delegation as current under the changed root authority.

non_claims: This profile does not implement or certify WIMSE.
This profile does not claim AXIOM-MESH had a delegation-currentness vulnerability.
Cryptographic or structural validity of a historical delegation chain is not evidence of current effect authorization.
